description: This file contains the main entry point and core components of a Flutter-based calculator app, including UI layout, styling, state management, input handling, and history persistence.

classes.name: AppColors
classes.description: Defines the color palette used throughout the app.

classes.name: HistoryItem
classes.description: Model class for storing calculator history entries with expression, result, and timestamp.

classes.name: CalculatorProvider
classes.description: State management class providing logic for calculator operations, history management, and expression evaluation.

classes.name: SmartCalcApp
classes.description: Root widget setting up theming and the main application UI.

classes.name: CalculatorScreen
classes.description: Main screen widget with responsive layout.

classes.name: _ResponsiveLayout
classes.description: Handles responsive design switching between portrait and landscape modes.

classes.name: _DisplayPanel
classes.description: UI component showing current expression, result, and action buttons.

classes.name: _IconActionButton
classes.description: Button widget for icon-based actions like copy, backspace, clear.

classes.name: _KeySpec
classes.description: Specification class for defining calculator keys.

classes.name: _CalcButton
classes.description: Widget for individual calculator buttons with styling and tap handling.

classes.name: _KeyType
classes.description: Enumeration for different types of calculator keys (digit, operator, function, equals).

classes.name: _KeypadPanel
classes.description: Widget containing all calculator keypad buttons and scientific functions.

classes.name: _HistoryPanel
classes.description: Widget displaying calculation history with tap-to-reuse functionality.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point; initializes and runs the SmartCalcApp.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies the current display value to the clipboard.

methods.name: applyFunction
methods.description: Applies scientific functions (sin, cos, tan, log, sqrt) to current input.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the current expression and updates display and history.

methods.name: inputDigit
methods.description: Adds a digit or decimal point to the current input.

methods.name: inputOperator
methods.description: Adds an operator to the current expression.

methods.name: backspace
methods.description: Removes last character from current input.

methods.name: reuseHistoryResult
methods.description: Loads a previous calculation result into current display.
